name: bonsai-js
test_note: Whole unit suite, about 20 s with 4 workers. tests/query.servers.test.ts skips itself without QUERY_SERVERS (never set); the one test that runs the bun binary ('keeps the names in a minified bundle', tests/round6-api.test.ts) is left out by name. --retry=2 (as in every grader): the suite has wall-clock assertions (tests/limits.test.ts and tests/partial.test.ts < 500 ms, several 2,000-3,000 ms checks) that a loaded machine can miss by luck; a test that passes on a retry counts as passed, one that fails three attempts as failed. The repository ships only bun.lock, so deps.lock names a package-lock.json made once from its package.json with npm --package-lock-only --before=2026-11-15.
